20261121-chemistry-e1-1.title: Wane ne ya haɗa daidai halayen kayan da
20261121-chemistry-e1-1.topic: Wane ne ya haɗa daidai halayen kayan da
20261121-chemistry-e1-1.goal: Aiwatar da ka'idojin Wane ne ya haɗa daidai halayen kayan da don warware matsalar bincike.
20261121-chemistry-e1-1.material: Wane ne ya haɗa daidai halayen kayan da ake yin 'rigar ruwan sama' da 'gilashin ninkaya' da su?
20261121-chemistry-e1-1.thinking.0: Wane ne ya haɗa daidai halayen kayan da
20261121-chemistry-e1-1.s.s1.prompt: Wane ne ya haɗa daidai halayen kayan da ake yin 'rigar ruwan sama' da 'gilashin ninkaya' da su?
20261121-chemistry-e1-1.s.s1.explain: Ana yin rigar ruwan sama da kayan da ba su ratsa ruwa (leda/roba) don kada ruwan sama ya jiƙa mutum, kuma ana yin gilashin ninkaya da roba ko gilashi mai bayyanawa don a ga abubuwa a cikin ruwa.
20261121-chemistry-e1-1.s.s1.hint.0: Kada ruwa ya shiga rigar ruwan sama; gilashin ninkaya kuma dole ne ya bar ka ka ga gaba sosai.
20261121-chemistry-e1-1.s.s1.hint.1: Ana tsara amfani bisa halayen kayan.
20261121-chemistry-e1-1.s.s1.o.o0: Rigar ruwan sama: ba ta barin ruwa ya ratsa ta (hana ruwa) / gilashin ninkaya: bayyanawa don a gani sosai
20261121-chemistry-e1-1.s.s1.o.o1: Rigar ruwan sama: kyakkyawar ɗaukar wutar lantarki / gilashin ninkaya: karyewa cikin sauƙi
20261121-chemistry-e1-1.s.s1.o.o2: Rigar ruwan sama: cin wuta cikin sauƙi / gilashin ninkaya: nauyi
20261121-chemistry-e1-1.s.s1.o.o3: Rigar ruwan sama: shan ruwa sosai / gilashin ninkaya: rashin bayyanawa

20261122-chemistry-e1-1.material: [Binciken muhalli mai zurfi] Roba tana da fa'idodin sauƙi, ƙarfi da rashin ruɓewa, amma idan aka jefar da ita ba ta ruɓewa a yanayi tsawon ɗaruruwan shekaru, kuma tana gurɓata muhalli. Wace hanyar ci gaban kimiyyar kayan aiki ce daidai don magance wannan?

20261122-chemistry-e2-1.title: Binciken ƙa'ida mai zurfi
20261122-chemistry-e2-1.goal: Aiwatar da ka'idojin Binciken ƙa'ida mai zurfi don warware matsalar bincike.
20261122-chemistry-e2-1.material: [Binciken ƙa'ida mai zurfi] Akwai ruwan gishiri da aka yi ta narkar da gishiri g 10 gaba ɗaya a cikin ruwa g 100. Idan aka auna nauyin dukkan wannan ruwan gishiri da ma'aunin lantarki, zai zama g nawa?
20261122-chemistry-e2-1.s.s1.prompt: [Binciken ƙa'ida mai zurfi] Akwai ruwan gishiri da aka yi ta narkar da gishiri g 10 gaba ɗaya a cikin ruwa g 100. Idan aka auna nauyin dukkan wannan ruwan gishiri da ma'aunin lantarki, zai zama g nawa?
20261122-chemistry-e2-1.s.s1.explain: Idan abu ya narke, ƙwayoyin abin da aka narkar (gishiri) suna warwatsewa tsakanin ƙwayoyin ruwa kawai, ba sa ɓacewa; don haka nauyin dukkan maganar yana kiyayewa daidai a g 110, wato jimillar nauyin ruwa da gishiri.
20261122-chemistry-e2-1.s.s1.hint.0: Ko da gishiri ya narke ba a gani, bai ɓace ba.

20261122-chemistry-e2-2.title: Menene dalilin da ruwa da man girki
20261122-chemistry-e2-2.topic: Menene dalilin da ruwa da man girki
20261122-chemistry-e2-2.goal: Aiwatar da ka'idojin Menene dalilin da ruwa da man girki don warware matsalar bincike.
20261122-chemistry-e2-2.material: Menene dalilin da ruwa da man girki, ko da an saka su a kwalba ɗaya aka girgiza da ƙarfi, suke sake rabuwa gaba ɗaya zuwa yadudduka biyu idan aka bar su na ɗan lokaci?
20261122-chemistry-e2-2.thinking.0: Menene dalilin da ruwa da man girki
20261122-chemistry-e2-2.s.s1.prompt: Menene dalilin da ruwa da man girki, ko da an saka su a kwalba ɗaya aka girgiza da ƙarfi, suke sake rabuwa gaba ɗaya zuwa yadudduka biyu idan aka bar su na ɗan lokaci?
20261122-chemistry-e2-2.s.s1.explain: Ruwa ƙwayar polar ne kuma man girki ƙwayar non-polar ne, don haka ba sa haɗuwa; yawan man girki (kusan 0.92 g/cm³) ya yi ƙasa da na ruwa (1.0 g/cm³), don haka yana yawo a babban Layer.
20261122-chemistry-e2-2.s.s1.hint.0: Ruwa yana da polarity, mai kuma ba shi da polarity, don haka ba sa narkar da juna.
20261122-chemistry-e2-2.s.s1.hint.1: Mai ya fi ruwa sauƙi (yawansa ya ragu) don haka yana yawo a sama.
20261122-chemistry-e2-2.s.s1.o.o0: Saboda man girki ba ya haɗuwa da ruwa kuma yawansa ya yi ƙasa da na ruwa, don haka yana yawo a sama
20261122-chemistry-e2-2.s.s1.o.o1: Saboda man girki yana shan ruwa
20261122-chemistry-e2-2.s.s1.o.o2: Saboda ruwa ya fi man girki ɗumi
20261122-chemistry-e2-2.s.s1.o.o3: Saboda man girki ya taurara ya zama ƙarfi
